name: Tiwari Taxo Images
author: Brijesh Tiwari

sections.description:
Tiwari Taxo Images lets you add beautiful images to WordPress taxonomies with a clean and simple interface.

Features:

  • Add images to categories
  • Add images to custom taxonomies
  • WooCommerce product category support
  • Works with custom post types
  • Live image preview using WordPress media library
  • Modern admin dashboard
  • Image column inside taxonomy tables

Perfect for:

  • WordPress Categories
  • Tags
  • WooCommerce Product Categories
  • Custom Taxonomies

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate Tiwari Taxo Images
  3. Open Taxo Images from WordPress admin
  4. Enable the taxonomies you want
  5. Add images while creating or editing terms
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release of Tiwari Taxo Images
  • Taxonomy image upload support
  • WooCommerce category support
  • Modern admin UI
